newsitem.title: THAILAND: Morakot to produce soyoil in Thailand.
newsitem.headline: Morakot to produce soyoil in Thailand.

text.p: Morakot Industries Plc, a leading Thai palmoil producer, said on Wednesday that it would soon start to produce oil from soybeans and sunflower seeds.

The company said in a statement that its board had approved the plan and the firm will invest 320 million baht (US$12.8 million) over the next 18 months on construction and machinery for a new plant to undertake the production.
Its new factory would be on the outskirts of Bangkok, the company said without detailing its start-up schedule.
The diversification was aimed at making Morakot's products more competitive in the market, it added.
"Based on the feasibility of the project, there is potential for soybean and sunflower seed oil," it said.
"The market is getting more competitive now. Therefore, if the company does not expand its business and produce oil from other raw materials, it may face problems in the future," it added.
